description: Spawn an agent-manager–managed research run that uses L2 endpoints and web-search CLI commands as tools, plans and decomposes the query, loops (search → read → find gaps → re-search), verifies across sources, and emits a cited brief, reusing existing agentic infrastructure with no hand-rolled loop plumbing.

requirements.description: Spawn a research run via the agent-manager lifecycle (no hand-rolled loop plumbing) that uses L2 endpoints and web-search CLI commands as registered tools. The agent plans and decomposes the input query, iterates through a search → read → gap-identification → re-search loop, verifies claims across multiple sources, and emits a cited brief upon completion. The agent reuses existing agentic infrastructure exclusively.
requirements.title: L3 Iterative Research Agent — Agent-Manager-Managed Research Run

validation.notes: The L3 task contract directs the agent to decompose the input into focused sub-queries [criterion revised from auto-generated 'in-process decomposition function' framing: by design (DECISIONS.md — L3 is an agent-manager run, no hand-rolled loop plumbing) decomposition is delegated to the agent LLM via the task prompt; the testable surface is the prompt contract, which mandates researching gaps via focused L2 sub-queries. LLM output cardinality is validated live, not in unit tests]

The L3 task contract directs the agent to identify what the gathered findings do NOT cover and re-search those gaps [criterion revised from auto-generated 'in-process gap-identification step' framing: gap identification is delegated to the agent LLM via the task prompt by design (DECISIONS.md); the prompt contract mandating gap-directed iteration over the gathered set is the testable surface]
Agent tool registry for a research run includes L2 fetch endpoint and findings CLI commands as callable tools
L3 agent-manager run smoke test: spawn a research run, verify the agent invokes L2 tools at least once, completes within the configured iteration budget, and emits a brief with at least one finding
Verify the L3 run uses agent-manager run lifecycle (spawn, step, complete) and does not implement its own loop
Verify the agent re-searches at least once when gap identification produces unresolved questions in a controlled test scenario

L3 research run completes within a configurable maximum iteration budget (default: 10 loops) and does not run indefinitely [budget implemented as a task-contract directive: every L3 prompt carries the loop budget (default research.DefaultMaxResearchLoops=10, lever WEB_SEARCH_L3_MAX_LOOPS) with an explicit converge-when-spent instruction; the hard run lifecycle bound (timeout/cancel) is owned by agent-manager per the L3 design decision]
A user can request a deep research run and receive a cited brief without manually orchestrating multiple searches
The L3 agent produces more thorough results than a single L2 call by iterating over gaps

title: L3 Iterative Research Agent
